basis: Not a Bessemer position: the row is the buyer of a portfolio company's assets (the sale-consideration class, Erik 2026-09-22; decisions.md R6 and D5). The firm's list carried PSINet from 2000 to January 2019 (investment 1993, exit 1995), and its February 2019 list names Cogent Communications in PSINet's place, with no investment year and no partner. PSINet filed for Chapter 11 on 2001-06-01 and Cogent, founded in 1999, bought most of its United States assets in April 2002 (Wikipedia, PSINet), seven years after the firm's exit. No Bessemer round in Cogent is on record and the EDGAR full-text sweep finds no Cogent filing naming a Bessemer fund. The Bessemer position is the row psinet.
